from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import range_boundaries
from pathlib import Path

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/41410/1_41410_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/41410_0_e7184fd0/1_41410_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb.active

# Extract all Lighting rows from the source table in columns B:D, starting below the headers.
lighting_rows = []
for row in range(3, ws.max_row + 1):
    item = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value
    if isinstance(item, str) and item.strip().lower() == "lighting":
        lighting_rows.append([
            ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value,
            ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value,
            ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value
        ])

# Fill only the requested answer range F4:H6.
# The output table starts one row above the answer range, so F4:H6 receives Lighting records 2 through 4.
answer_range = "F4:H6"
min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_range)
output_first_data_row = min_row - 1

for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    lighting_index = r - output_first_data_row
    for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
        value_index = c - min_col
        ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value = (
            lighting_rows[lighting_index][value_index]
            if lighting_index < len(lighting_rows)
            else None
        )

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
